amountPolicy: Raw tax reference prices only; never interpreted as retail selling prices or used in application calculations. No conversion applied.
headerPolicy: Original header spelling/spacing and source columns preserved; no implicit merge-cell fill-down. Every vehicle JSONL row also preserves original OOXML cell types in fieldCellTypesRaw.
classificationPolicy: Government tax vehicle/type/name observations only, not a retail manufacturer→generation→grade master. No trim/year/parent code invented.
